assert.description: Verify SBDH sender and receiver identifiers match the invoice or credit note endpoint identifiers.
Standard billing succeeds when sender and receiver identifiers match the supplier and customer endpoints.
Standard billing succeeds when sender and receiver identifiers match the supplier and customer endpoints, ignoring case.
Standard billing succeeds when identifiers match the endpoints, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace in the SBDH identifier and the endpoint values.
Standard billing succeeds when identifiers containing an internal space match the endpoints, as a space can be part of an identifier.
Standard billing fails when the receiver identifier does not match the customer endpoint.
Standard billing fails when the sender identifier does not match the supplier endpoint.
Standard billing fails when the receiver identifier lacks an internal space that is present in the customer endpoint.
Standard billing fails when the sender identifier has more internal spaces than the supplier endpoint.
Standard billing fails when the sender identifier has a different scheme than the supplier endpoint, even if the value matches.
Standard billing fails when the supplier endpoint schemeID has leading or trailing whitespace, as attribute values are not trimmed.
Self-billing succeeds when sender and receiver identifiers are swapped to match the customer and supplier endpoints.
Self-billing succeeds when sender and receiver identifiers match the customer and supplier endpoints, ignoring case.
Self-billing fails when the receiver identifier does not match the supplier endpoint.
Self-billing fails when the sender identifier does not match the customer endpoint.
Unsupported customization and profile combinations are allowed without endpoint validation, even when the SBDH identifiers do not match the invoice endpoints.
Standard billing credit notes succeed when sender and receiver identifiers match the supplier and customer endpoints.
Standard billing credit notes succeed when sender and receiver identifiers match the supplier and customer endpoints, ignoring case.
Standard billing credit notes fail when the receiver identifier does not match the customer endpoint.
Standard billing credit notes fail when the sender identifier does not match the supplier endpoint.
Self-billing credit notes succeed when sender and receiver identifiers are swapped to match the customer and supplier endpoints.
Self-billing credit notes fail when the receiver identifier does not match the supplier endpoint.
Self-billing credit notes fail when the sender identifier does not match the customer endpoint.
Unsupported customization and profile combinations are allowed without endpoint validation for credit notes, even when the SBDH identifiers do not match the credit note endpoints.
